title: Net reaction enthalpy sign
statement:
Products have a coefficient-weighted formation enthalpy sum of −820 kJ; reactants total −750 kJ. What is the reaction enthalpy?

[_]{a}

explanations: Products minus reactants gives an exothermic reaction.
This adds the two signed sums.
This ignores the signs in both sums.

hints: Subtracting a negative adds its magnitude.
solution: Subtract the full signed reactant sum: −820−(−750)=−70 kJ.
